title: Estética de Foto Digital Sony CyberShot 2005 con Sello de Fecha
prompt: A low-resolution digital photo taken on a 2005 Sony CyberShot. A group of Japanese teenagers hanging out in a Shibuya mall food court in Tokyo. Harsh on-camera flash, slightly blown-out highlights, digital noise in the shadows. The skin texture looks slightly waxy due to early digital processing. An orange date stamp appears in the bottom right corner reading '18/01/2005'. Candid, awkward angles, Mixi photo aesthetic.
